newsitem.title: FINLAND: BANK OF FINLAND NEW MARKKA & TALOUS DUE APRIL 9.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF FINLAND NEW MARKKA & TALOUS DUE APRIL 9.

text.p: The Bank of Finland will hold a news conference on Wednesday, April 9 at 1400/1200 GMT in connection with the release of the first 1997 issue of its Markka & Talous publication, the central bank said in a statement on Monday.
Bank of Finland governor Sirkka Hamalainen will present the economic prospects outlined in the leading article of the quarterly publication, it said.
